# R06 — comparison size and conservative estimate policy

Status: **complete for pilot policy and authored sensitivity contract**, October 8, 2026 Eastern. Owner: cost research with software review. Receiving slices: D09, S02, S03, S04, S05. Exact source baseline is P00 HEAD `43c95c020f7260808270c89ae9eaeb61963d34be`, source digest `7b1c952adc1f73d7e73f836bce713483bfbc2be858f548d305194a0bb5f503ea`; R05 proposal/vectors and R01 reviewed pilot scope are dependencies. This document selects routine product defaults, not empirically calibrated market safety guarantees. No account, acquisition, runtime or source change occurred.

## Pilot size, capital and comparable results

Default **$100 prefunded risk-capital ceiling** requires no stake entry. Choose the maximum valid single-candidate quantity on its evidenced unit/minimum/increment grid within the ceiling; arb search chooses the best evaluated feasible allocation within the same ceiling and bounded search contract. Include entry acquisition, unavoidable entry charges, and independently required prefunded liabilities/holds once. Never use face payout as deployed capital. Use actual deployed capital as the return denominator, excluding unused ceiling residual. Details show both the $100 ceiling and actual deployed dollars/quantity; residual from a coarse unit grid is visible. A $44 deployed authored example therefore uses $44, not $100, as denominator. Same ceiling/category/probability conditioning/fee channel is required to compare rows. Depth-limited smaller sizes appear in a separate explicit size basis or as Details sensitivity, never silently substitute into the $100 ranking basis.

An optional Details override changes the common comparison ceiling and invalidates all dependent results. It is not an entry gate. No evidence suggests that another cross-venue unit basis is more comparable than funded dollars. Default execution assumption is taker, standalone portfolio, already-funded balances. Maker results are separately authored/hypothetical and exclude contingent credits. No claim of observed account positions or fees follows from this default.

R01 scope reviewed with market research: NFL/NCAAF/NBA/NCAAB/MLB/NHL; aggregate configured full-game h2h/spreads/totals for Novig/ProphetX/Pinnacle. Native ordinary runtime remains NFL Kalshi/Polymarket US. Other documented selectors await bounded D06 admission. Only R01 admitted cells and R02/R03 reviewed payout meanings can receive ordinary estimates. Pinnacle is a reference; no execution allocation uses it.

## Explicit default policy inputs

| Input | Pilot choice | What it means / local refusal |
|---|---|---|
| Adverse execution movement | Increase acquisition price per $1 face by `max(evidenced legal price tick, $0.01)` for taker scenario. | Reprice on a legal grid and recompute fee at adverse price. Sportsbook conversion needs evidenced stake/payout units; without them, no bounded movement estimate. If no legal price below maximum exists, conservative estimate unavailable. A chosen 1-cent buffer is a stress assumption, not a fill guarantee. |
| Fee rounding | Use R05 documented aggregation. Exact fill split if supplied; supported proven upper bound if unknown. | US taker cumulative cap exists; Kalshi documented two-grid envelope requires complete fills. Novig each-fill rounding needs a declared fragment bound for a conservative total. No bound from unbounded fragmentation. Unknown ProphetX rounding gets named scenario only. |
| Quote age | Pregame execution/reference max 900 seconds; live max 15 seconds; negative/missing source age fails. | Based on source quote time, never receipt, socket, heartbeat or last check. Chosen 900 seconds matches ordinary aggregate cadence while exposing stale snapshots; 15-second live ceiling is a deliberately narrow pilot admission policy. Not calibrated accuracy. |
| Depth | Consume evidenced price ladders/size once with shared-liquidity constraints. | No fabricated depth. Missing depth may allow a labeled quantity/fee hypothetical estimate when its units/rules are complete, but no depth-qualified conservative ranking. Insufficient depth leaves target-size value unavailable; supported-size sensitivity is separate. |
| Credits | Zero future/contingent credits in conservative funding. | Deterministic documented entry rounding refund is accounted once in net debit. Other rebates remain separate Details scenarios. |
| Extra execution reserve | Default $0 extra arbitrary reserve. | Adverse price and fee bounds already fund the chosen stress. Independently evidenced prefunded settlement liability/hold is separate; unknown mandatory charges cannot be covered by an invented dollar reserve. |

The existing application age policy of 1,800 seconds remains the implemented baseline. The 900-second pregame and 15-second live limits are deliberate proposed transitions for S03/D07, not implemented facts. Rebind affected acceptance vectors when adopted.

Age rejection withholds the dependent ranking metric, while exact observed price/clock and reason remain inspectable. Cancellation, suspension, delayed status, stale reference and incompatible phase locally withhold dependent estimates. Complete-state and conditional-state categories remain distinct. Exceptional states are never assigned a probability by this cost policy. Reference expiry cannot hide healthy venue prices.

## Count once and preserve monotonic sensitivity

For each outcome, net profit equals returned payout and returned refundable hold less actual entry cash debit and consumed settlement/other charges. A refundable hold enters required capital once and returns in outcomes where unused. A consumed buffer/charge reduces profit once. Commission already withheld from payout must not be deducted again. Funding reserve is not automatically an expense. Existing `depth._allocation` subtracts its `execution_reserve_usd` from every outcome; receiving software must bind that field only as an explicitly consumed conservative loss or introduce typed refundable-hold cashflows. Do not route an unused refundable hold into that path unchanged.

Freeze quantity/allocation for base/conservative sensitivity. Higher adverse price/cost bounds cannot improve any fixed-allocation scenario profit, expected profit or minimum profit. If denominator also increases, monotonic ROI assertions require positive capital and careful treatment of negative profits; **a more negative profit divided by larger capital can appear less negative**, so compare profit first and reject an improved percentage caused solely by denominator expansion. For paired buffer sensitivity, freeze the disclosed common capital basis: actual prefunded acquisition plus the worst permitted movement/fee allowance, with unused allowance a refundable hold. This capital is deployed for the comparison even when a scenario returns the allowance. Compute every compared percentage on that same funded basis. If increasing the configured bound needs more capital, rebase both compared scenarios to the expanded funded basis or report dollar sensitivity only; do not label cross-basis percentages a monotonic comparison. Actual stressed required cash remains visible and must respect the ceiling. Resizing after a price/ceiling revision is a distinct result revision, not a monotonicity comparison.

Independent vectors in [policy vectors](comparison-r06-policy-vectors-20261008.json) cover $50 deployed/$55 payout: no cost 10%, $.50 cost 9%, $1 cost 8%, $6 cost −2%. A $10 refundable hold adds funded capital once: profit $5, denominator $60, return 8⅓%; consuming $2 of it leaves profit $3, denominator $60, return 5%. A separate negative example records why changing denominators can otherwise falsify monotonicity. Quote ages 899/900 seconds admit pregame; 901 fails; live 15 admits/16 fails. Missing source clocks fail. These are independent authored checks, not measured market behavior.

## Acceptance and handoff

One zero-input capital policy, optional Details override, fixed-allocation monotonic profit checks, reserve accounting, units, rounding/fragmentation limits, age/depth refusal and sensitivity are specified. R05/R01 gates are reviewable. Software must preserve the actual input revisions, probability condition and estimate label through D09/S02/S03/S04/S05. Machine vectors are portable expected values; runtime integration, actual quote/depth applicability, Q03 bounded live qualification and owner acceptance remain pending. Unknown cost rules cannot be replaced by these stress defaults.

Verification: all three machine JSON artifacts parsed; 17 independent fee vectors, six policy cashflows and seven source-age cases were checked. Fixed-basis dollar profit is monotonic across the four cost cases. No production test or live qualification was claimed.
